topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of cancer therapy and outlines the key learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate standard local and systemic treatment modalities alongside non-specific toxicity and efflux-mediated drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that leverage cancer-specific vulnerabilities, checkpoint defects, and synthetic lethal DNA repair mechanisms.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how oncogenic kinases are therapeutically targeted with small-molecule inhibitors and analyse the mechanisms by which tumors develop drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how engineered antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates specifically target tumor-associated surface antigens to destroy cancer cells.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and immunotherapy approaches
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the biology of immune surveillance and examine therapeutic approaches to reactivate or engineer T cells against tumors.

topics.label: Clinical challenges, historical progress, and future perspectives in oncology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on historical treatment successes, ongoing clinical complexities, and future ethical and therapeutic paradigms in cancer care.
